title_cyr: Кинисала Рума на вода да оди
title_latin: Kinisala Ruma na voda da odi
title_en: Ruma set out to go for water
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional Veles song; the notes give the meanings of чапкан, угурсуз, сарош and that Kojnik is a Veles neighborhood. 'Ситниот барут, клетото срце' is my reading: the shot hits her forehead and heart.

lines.cyr: Кинисала Рума ајде, на вода да оди,
lines.lat: Kinisala Ruma ajde, na voda da odi,
lines.en: Ruma set out, come on, to go for water,

lines.cyr: вода да донесе, глава да се мие.
lines.lat: voda da donese, glava da se mie.
lines.en: to bring water, to wash her head.

lines.cyr: Ќолук да им прави на ергените,
lines.lat: Ḱoluk da im pravi na ergenite,
lines.en: To flirt with the bachelors,

lines.cyr: на чапканите, на угурсузите,
lines.lat: na čapkanite, na ugursuzite,
lines.en: with the street-rakes, with the good-for-nothings,

lines.cyr: на сарошите, на којничани.
lines.lat: na sarošite, na kojničani.
lines.en: with the drunkards, with the Kojnik folk.

lines.cyr: Кога ми дочуле џанам, којнички ергени,
lines.lat: Koga mi dočule džanam, kojnički ergeni,
lines.en: When they heard, my dear, the Kojnik bachelors,

lines.cyr: па ја зедоа на око, на нишан,
lines.lat: pa ja zedoa na oko, na nišan,
lines.en: they took her in their sights, as a target,

lines.cyr: ми ја удрија на умното чело,
lines.lat: mi ja udrija na umnoto čelo,
lines.en: and struck her on her clever forehead,

lines.cyr: а ситниот барут, клетото срце.
lines.lat: a sitniot barut, kletoto srce.
lines.en: and the fine gunpowder, the poor heart.

lines.cyr: Кај што ми паднала Рума, крв подлеала,
lines.lat: Kaj što mi padnala Ruma, krv podleala,
lines.en: Where Ruma fell, blood flowed,

lines.cyr: кај што стоеше, сонце грееше,
lines.lat: kaj što stoeše, sonce greeše,
lines.en: where she stood, the sun shone,

lines.cyr: кога одеше, ветер вееше,
lines.lat: koga odeše, veter veeše,
lines.en: when she walked, the wind blew,

lines.cyr: кога збореше, бисер велеше.
lines.lat: koga zboreše, biser veleše.
lines.en: when she spoke, she spoke pearls.

lines.cyr: Кога ми дочула џанам, нејзината мајка,
lines.lat: Koga mi dočula džanam, nejzinata majka,
lines.en: When she heard, my dear, her mother,

lines.cyr: трчум, трчум, трчум, плачум, плачум, плачум,
lines.lat: trčum, trčum, trčum, plačum, plačum, plačum,
lines.en: running, running, running, weeping, weeping, weeping,

lines.cyr: косите си куби, прстите си крши:
lines.lat: kosite si kubi, prstite si krši:
lines.en: she tears her hair, breaks her fingers:

lines.cyr: - Оф леле, леле, Рума, Румена,
lines.lat: - Of lele, lele, Ruma, Rumena,
lines.en: - Oh woe, woe, Ruma, Rumena,

lines.cyr: една на мајка, една на татко!
lines.lat: edna na majka, edna na tatko!
lines.en: the only one to her mother, the only one to her father!

lines.cyr: Нели тебе Румо мори, мајка те учеше
lines.lat: Neli tebe Rumo mori, majka te učeše
lines.en: Didn't your mother teach you, Ruma, hey,

lines.cyr: ќолук да не правиш на ергените,
lines.lat: ḱoluk da ne praviš na ergenite,
lines.en: not to flirt with the bachelors,

lines.cyr: на чапканите, на угурсузите,
lines.lat: na čapkanite, na ugursuzite,
lines.en: with the street-rakes, with the good-for-nothings,

lines.cyr: на сарошите, на којничани?
lines.lat: na sarošite, na kojničani?
lines.en: with the drunkards, with the Kojnik folk?

lines.cyr: Кога ми дочуле џанам, нејзини другачки,
lines.lat: Koga mi dočule džanam, nejzini drugački,
lines.en: When they heard, my dear, her girlfriends,

lines.cyr: трчум, трчум, трчум, плачум, плачум, плачум,
lines.lat: trčum, trčum, trčum, plačum, plačum, plačum,
lines.en: running, running, running, weeping, weeping, weeping,

lines.cyr: косите си кубат, прстите си кршат:
lines.lat: kosite si kubat, prstite si kršat:
lines.en: they tear their hair, break their fingers:

lines.cyr: - Оф леле, леле, Рума, Румена,
lines.lat: - Of lele, lele, Ruma, Rumena,
lines.en: - Oh woe, woe, Ruma, Rumena,

lines.cyr: Рума, Румена, наша другачка.
lines.lat: Ruma, Rumena, naša drugačka.
lines.en: Ruma, Rumena, our girlfriend.

lines.cyr: Нели тебе Румо мори, сите те учевме
lines.lat: Neli tebe Rumo mori, site te učevme
lines.en: Didn't we all teach you, Ruma, hey,

lines.cyr: ќолук да не правиш на ергените,
lines.lat: ḱoluk da ne praviš na ergenite,
lines.en: not to flirt with the bachelors,

lines.cyr: на чапканите, на угурсузите,
lines.lat: na čapkanite, na ugursuzite,
lines.en: with the street-rakes, with the good-for-nothings,

lines.cyr: на сарошите, на којничани?
lines.lat: na sarošite, na kojničani?
lines.en: with the drunkards, with the Kojnik folk?
